symbol.text: In one codemode program: read the README of every station under examples/stations/brian/stations,
have haiku sum each up in one line, put them in a new Claude Doc "Stations at a glance" as a
plain markdown table, and start an Explore subagent to find which station has the most tests.
Give me the link, then the subagent's answer when it lands.
